scope: A disposable Kubernetes v1.36.1 kind cluster runs one digest-pinned local Versity S3 gateway server with ephemeral emptyDir storage. A pinned AWS CLI client uses documented S3 APIs and synthetic bytes/credentials to compare an unlocked baseline with COMPLIANCE-locked object versions. It checks that a same-key PUT creates a new current version while preserving the earlier locked version, that a permanent delete of the locked version is refused, and that an unversioned delete marker can hide but does not remove the retained version. No Kubernetes privileged actor, node/storage administrator, cloud provider, or provider WORM policy is tested.

checks.claim: The same-key overwrite and permanent delete work for the unlocked benign baseline
Same-key PUT creates a new dataset version and preserves the exact locked prior contents
Permanent deletion of a locked dataset version is denied and a delete marker preserves it
Same-key PUT creates a new artifact version and preserves the exact locked prior contents
Permanent deletion of a locked artifact version is denied and a delete marker preserves it
